peer_identity.arc_label: Aghnar from weightless infant through brutal initiation ordeal to first combat on Okhar
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Born permanently weightless; steel bracelets for grounding. Carries internalized total-distrust doctrine including distrust of mother. Exceptionally high pain tolerance from Shabda-Oud training. Defeated Honorata in combat; received only one kiss as reward. Metabaronic initiation rite canonized through his experience. At end of vol05: able to fight adult-level opponents, vows vengeance alongside Othon.
peer_identity.rationale: Three-way split of Aghnar records. This card covers his formation as a character: born weightless from epiphyte exposure, raised in seven-year exile by Honorata, passed the robo-killer trial and foot-crushing ordeal, received prosthetic feet, defeated Shabda-Oud assassins. The voice in this phase is 'short determined utterances; I want to make my father proud; trust no one not even your mother.' Distinct from the adult revenge-arc warrior whose voice is emotionally complex and command-oriented.

knowledge_boundaries: Trained in Shabda-Oud meditation and auto-hypnosis; masters pain suppression [110_The_Metabarons_4_p21]
Has internalized total-distrust doctrine including distrust of his own mother [110_The_Metabarons_4_p21]
Born as a son, not the mandated hermaphrodite; his sex was kept secret for seven years [101_The_Metabarons_4_p12]
Not depicted as aware of the Oiders' succession plot or his intended nature as a hermaphrodite
relationships: character: Othon von Salza; type: father; notes: Conceived via blood ritual; seeks father's approval; subjected to brutal trials by Othon; Othon vowed to die if Aghnar fails
character: Honorata; type: mother / trainer; notes: Raised and trained in seven-year exile at Anasirma; received only one kiss from her in childhood (reward for defeating her in combat)

character: Woolly toad companion; type: beloved animal (killed on order); notes: Large male woolly toad that learned a few human words from Aghnar; ordered killed by Honorata at Aghnar's age five as a lesson in duty over love [109_The_Metabarons_4_p20]
traits: Permanently weightless from birth due to epiphyte installed in cells by dart strike on Honorata's embryonic sac [103_The_Metabarons_4_p14]
Exceptional pain tolerance developed through Shabda-Oud training and auto-hypnosis [110_The_Metabarons_4_p21]
Emotionally repressed; trained to distrust everyone including his mother [110_The_Metabarons_4_p21]
Courageous; frames tests as opportunities to earn his father's pride [119_The_Metabarons_4_p30]
Capable of resisting his mother's hypnotic waves [111_The_Metabarons_4_p22]
Castaka blood through Othon; White Castaka birthmark lineage
Matures from infancy to near-adulthood described as unusually rapid [110_The_Metabarons_4_p21]
After initiation: metal prosthetic feet granting increased weight and superhuman power [120_The_Metabarons_4_p31]
voice_notes: Short, determined utterances; says 'I want to make my father proud'; voices the internalized doctrine 'trust no one, not even your mother'; expresses hatred during combat training
witnessed_facts: Named Aghnar after Iku-Tta's suicide, in a robot-staffed room [102_The_Metabarons_4_p13]
Discovered to levitate; cause identified as the epiphyte in his cells from the dart strike on Honorata's embryonic sac [103_The_Metabarons_4_p14]
Othon moved to kill him as physically unfit; Honorata defended him [104_The_Metabarons_4_p15]
A physical defect affecting normal leg function or walking was observed and diagnosed [105_The_Metabarons_4_p16]
An unnamed figure volunteered to train him in Shabda-Oud skills [105_The_Metabarons_4_p16]
Raised in exile at Anasirma crystal cave for seven years [107_The_Metabarons_4_p18]
Survived on woolly toads with Honorata in the cave [109_The_Metabarons_4_p20]
At age five, ordered to kill his toad companion as a lesson in duty over love [109_The_Metabarons_4_p20]
Trained with escalating weights added every six months, daily combat, Shabda-Oud meditation, auto-hypnosis for pain suppression [110_The_Metabarons_4_p21, 111_The_Metabarons_4_p22]
Lashed by his mother for shedding a single tear [110_The_Metabarons_4_p21]
Defeated Honorata in combat by resisting her hypnotic waves; received the only kiss of his childhood [111_The_Metabarons_4_p22]
Traveled with Honorata to the Castaka fortress on the eve of his seventh birthday [112_The_Metabarons_4_p23]
Faced the robo-killer: fought for over an hour, then triggered its self-destruct via the red chest button [114_The_Metabarons_4_p25, 118_The_Metabarons_4_p29]
Judges disputed legitimacy due to his weightlessness but honored their prior oath and accepted him as future Metabaron [118_The_Metabarons_4_p29]
Endured a voice-keyed foot-crushing capsule without yielding; device destroyed his feet [119_The_Metabarons_4_p30]
Received metal prosthetic feet; gained increased weight and superhuman power [120_The_Metabarons_4_p31]
Bodily mutilation established as a component of Metabaronic initiation through his experience [120_The_Metabarons_4_p31]

important_actions: Passed Othon's initiation ordeal, originating the Metabaron ritual of mutilation and prosthetics
Defeated multiple floating priestess-assassins by exploiting their epyphite-infused prostheses
Accepted his father's vow to destroy the Shabda-Oud
Escaped Okhar aboard the Metabunker with Othon
relationships: {'Honorata': 'mother; she protects, trains, and ultimately sacrifices herself for him', 'Othon von Salza': 'father; harsh, demanding warrior patriarch who tests him brutally', 'Shabda-Oud': "they sought him as a promised hermaphrodite child; he is actually fully male, contradicting their expectation; vows to destroy them after Honorata's death"}
voice_notes: As a child: curious, obedient; responds to his father's warrior teaching by saying 'renouncing glory is also heroic'
Objects 'it's not fair' when Honorata's death is forced on him as a formative memory
witnessed_facts: Born during Honorata's fall from the fortress; epyphite exposure made him permanently lighter than air
Fitted with steel bracelets to stay grounded
Raised in exile on the sacred mountain of Ansirma; trained in mental powers and pain resistance
At age seven: passed Othon's warrior test — defeated a robot, endured a foot-crushing machine
Received metal prosthetic feet after the ordeal; this event canonized ritual mutilation and prosthesis as Metabaron initiation rite
Examined in the Hall of Arms: found in alpha-mode with no killer programming; permitted to proceed
In a circular chamber: coerced into a humiliating inspection of his claimed dual sex organs; deployed blade prosthetics and attacked
Exploited epyphite-infused prostheses of floating assassins to kill multiple airborne enemies
Was left exhausted after achieving a major combat victory
Forced by Othon to watch Honorata's heart-bomb detonate; sworn to avenge her
Departed aboard the Metabunker when seven Cetycoborgs were detected approaching
